evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.938 Torr at the start of growth with Ar at 100.4 sccm.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.208 Torr despite essentially unchanged temperature and argon flow; this warrants investigation but does not identify a fault.
Temperature 750.3 C and Ar 100.1 sccm closely match setpoints; controller reports running, but these do not verify atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-stage pressure limits and a leak/exhaust-conductance check would clarify the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
